configuration.description: Entity Specific and Global Email Templates
configuration.fetchxml: <fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" savedqueryid="21b8d323-06c2-4cde-b756-95b86f0b3ea1"><entity name="template"><attribute name="title" /><attribute name="templatetypecode" /><attribute name="createdby" /><attribute name="ispersonal" /><attribute name="languagecode" /><attribute name="templateid" /><order attribute="templatetypecode" descending="false" /><order attribute="title" descending="false" /></entity></fetch>

layoutxml.xmlWithLogicalObject: <grid name="resultset" object="logical:template" jump="title" select="1" icon="1" preview="1"><row name="result" id="templateid"><cell name="title" width="300" /><cell name="templatetypecode" width="125" cellType="Crm.EmailTemplateGlobal" /><cell name="ispersonal" width="125" /></row></grid>

configuration.name: Email Templates Sorted View
configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*SelectStart*/select  "template0".[title] as "title" , "template0".[templatetypecode] as "templatetypecode" , "template0".[createdby!id] as "createdby!id" , "template0".[createdby!logicalname] as "createdby!logicalname" , "template0".[createdby!name] as "createdby!name" , "template0".[ispersonal] as "ispersonal" , "template0".[languagecode] as "languagecode" , "template0".[templateid] as "templateid"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  Template as "template0"  left outer join EntityView as "EVLL0" on ("EVLL0".ObjectTypeCode = "template0".TemplateTypeCode) left outer join LocalizedLabelView as "LL0" on ("LL0".ObjectId = "EVLL0".EntityId and "LL0".ObjectColumnName = 'LocalizedName' and "LL0".LanguageId = @LanguageId0) /*FromEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by   "LL0".Label  asc , "template0".[title] asc/*OrderByEnd*/
